title: WHUN
intro:
A clothing brand built around one question:
***WH***o’s ***UN***der the clothes?

items.text: Most brands you wear end up defining you to everyone else. ***WHUN*** starts from the opposite belief — the clothes are just how you carry what's underneath.
Clothing is one of the first things we notice, but it is only the surface. What matters is the person underneath — their story, beliefs and thoughts.
The name ***WHUN*** was created from the phrase ***WH***o is ***UN***der the clothes?” It turns the brand’s central belief into a question: not what someone wears, but who is wearing it.

The wordmark has enough attitude to hold a chest print — and enough discipline to sit on a small label. That's the brief it was built to: each drop leads with its own idea, so the mark steps forward only when the piece needs it. The one detail that never changes is the question mark — the name's meaning, kept in the smallest element.

A vivid green — the one constant across every drop, doing the job the mark can't always do: making ***WHUN*** recognizable at a glance.

A bold, condensed typeface that stays the same everywhere it appears — labels, tags, packaging — same rhythm, different volume.

One question, asked differently on every drop — always the same idea underneath.
That's the whole job: a brand distinct enough to survive changing completely from one release to the next.
